title: branching-story-kit story manifest
description: Story-graph manifest consumed by StoryEngine (branching-story-kit by Ouba Studio, MIT).

id.description: Stable story identifier used in save files.

start.description: Scene id of the opening scene.

initialState.description: Default state (relationship meters, flags, inventory) merged with per-session overrides.

body.description: Scene prose. {{stateKey}} placeholders are interpolated from the reader's state.

tag.description: Optional UI label (e.g. 'Scene 2 of 4'). Passed through untouched.

next.description: Target scene id. Required unless `href` is set.

requires.description: Minimum numeric state values required for the choice to be visible.

effects.description: Numbers are added to the current value; strings/booleans are assigned.

href.description: External link (store page, sequel, survey). The engine never navigates these for you.
